description: Returns the UK or Australian online shelf-price index over time, oldest week first, up to 26 weeks: level, week-on-week and four-week change, matched counts. Headline rows unless recordType says otherwise: retailer and class narrow other kinds, e.g. recordType class. Posted online shelf prices, not prices paid; not a CPI. Levels are not price levels and do not show which retailer is cheaper. list_index_vintages gives the weeks held. Product-level rows are not served: see about_the_data.

class.description: Only rows for this product class id, e.g. "dairy-eggs"; needs a recordType that has class rows, e.g. "class".

fromVintage.description: First ISO week, e.g. "2026-W42". Omit for up to 26 weeks ending at toVintage.

recordType.description: Kind of row, e.g. "class". Omit for "headline".

retailer.description: Only rows for this retailer id, e.g. "tesco" (UK) or "aldi_au" (AU); needs a recordType that has retailer rows, e.g. "retailer".

toVintage.description: Last ISO week, e.g. "2026-W45". Omit for the latest published week.

name: get_index_series
title: Shelf-price index over several weeks
